create.title: Signed affine-cone estimate for the top M2 block
create.statement_tex: For the exact top-endpoint transform, prove uniformly for dyadic 1<=L<=X^(1/4) that T_end,L=sum_(h asymp L, h odd) sum_(ceil(h/4)<=m<=h) chi_4(h) a_end(h,m)e(sqrt(Xhm)) <<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon, where a_end is the actual normalized Vaaler/profile symbol. The symbol is smooth in the cone interior and at the upper support edge but has a hard affine lower edge m=ceil(h/4) where W(1)=1. This estimate implies the top M2 block target because the endpoint and transform errors are target-sized.
create.next_action: Exploit the exact odd-h affine cone before absolute values. Audit whether M1 supplies a complementary cone with matching actual amplitudes, but do not infer cancellation without an exact combined formula.

update.reason_for_promotion: The one-sided Poisson formula, half-weight, principal-value boundary, odd-frequency separation, stationary cone, and Vaaler-weighted error sums were derived and independently hostile-audited. The audit corrected the exact separation minimum and boundary scopes without affecting the transform.
update.statement_tex: Let y=floor(sqrt X), q=X/y^2, w_end(d)=W(d/y)1_(d<=y), and let 1<=h<=H_y=floor(yX^(-1/4)) be odd. Then dist(hX/(4y^2),Z)>=1/8 for sufficiently large X, and the closest stationary point is >>y^(1/4) stationary widths from d=y. One-sided Poisson with full endpoint weight gives sum_(d<=y) W(d/y)e(hX/(4d)) = e(hX/(4y))/(1-e(hX/(4y^2))) + e(1/8)(hX)^(1/4)/2 sum_(m=ceil(h/4))^h W(sqrt(qh/(4m)))m^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xhm)) + O_W(log(2+h)). The endpoint is O(1) on each positive dyadic h-block and for the actual two-sided real-even block; the weighted errors are O_W(log^2 H). Thus the hard endpoint is reduced to the signed affine-cone estimate M9-M2-top-endpoint-signed-cone.
update.next_action: Prove M9-M2-top-endpoint-signed-cone. Do not use the smooth full-line transform at the affine lower edge and do not hide the principal-value endpoint term.
For smooth interior blocks prove the outside-absolute small-gcd quarter-packet estimate; for the top block prove the exact signed affine-cone estimate.

reject.reason: The included integer endpoint contributes an explicit half weight and a nonzero principal-value cotangent boundary term.
The exact minimum is 1/4-h_*(X-y^2)/(4y^2), although a fixed 1/8 lower bound holds for large X.
An exact-square actual-coefficient family gives a sharp logarithmic positive-frequency boundary. O(1) holds dyadically and after the actual two-sided real-even pairing.
Endpoint separation removes a Fresnel seam but gives no cancellation in the transformed signed affine cone.

no_change.reason: The top signed cone and smooth interior packet estimates remain open.
The final theorem remains conditional on open M9.

round_assessment.reason: Round 8 closes the hard endpoint transform and all boundary/error seams, while correctly retaining the signed affine-cone estimate as the first unproved step.
